pauseReasonKind.description: Only high_hard_bounce_rate can be cleared through the resume endpoint. over_email_limit lifts automatically once the account has email allowance again.

canSelfResume.description: Whether POST /sending-status/resume will succeed right now.

supported.description: Whether this pause reason is self-resumable at all.

aiReviewStatus.description: State of the automated sender-health review opened when the pause was created.

unavailableReason.description: The gate blocking resume. Null when resume is available.

senderHealth.description: Null when the workspace has no metrics record yet or sender-health analytics are temporarily unavailable. Pause state and remediation remain available during an analytics outage.

bounceScopedSent.description: Non-test sends counted from the bounce reset watermark - the denominator for hard- and soft-bounce rates.

complaintScopedSent.description: Non-test sends counted from the complaint reset watermark - the denominator for complaint rates.

expiresAt.description: Always null. Enforcement totals are all-time from the watermark, so a paused rate never expires on its own.

steps.description: Ordered next steps for the current state.

rate.description: Percentage of the applicable bounceScopedSent or complaintScopedSent denominator.

SenderHealthThresholdBound.description: Threshold that applies at this send volume. Either bound may be null when the tier does not use it.

FrequencyCap.description: At most maxEmails marketing emails (campaigns plus marketing sequence emails) per contact in any rolling windowHours.

maxEmails.description: Most marketing emails one contact may receive in the window.

TrackingDomain.description: The company tracking domain. Every sending domain uses it for tracked links and opens. It never gates sending; until it verifies, or when it is broken or removed, links use the shared Sequenzy tracking domain.

status.description: Verification status of the CNAME and HTTPS certificate. not_started until the DNS setup is confirmed or checked.

active.description: True while verified. New emails use this domain only while active.

everVerified.description: True once this hostname has verified. A failed domain that was verified before is broken rather than unfinished.

strictBotFilteringEnabled.description: Opt-in aggressive bot detection (strict user-agent patterns, datacenter and Microsoft Azure IPs, fast campaign and sequence clicks from IPs clicking other recipients' emails, cross-send IP sweeps). Off by default; enabling it can lower reported open and click rates.

unsubscribeTrackingEnabled.description: Whether to track unsubscribe link clicks. When false, Sequenzy unsubscribe links go directly to https://sequenzy.com, even with a custom tracking domain. Actual unsubscribes and their email attribution are still recorded.

transactionalOpenTrackingEnabled.description: Open tracking default for sends through the Send Email API. Account-wide open tracking must also be enabled; per-send trackingSettings can only opt out.

transactionalClickTrackingEnabled.description: Click tracking default for sends through the Send Email API. Account-wide click tracking must also be enabled; per-send trackingSettings can only opt out.

consent.description: Signup consent settings, as opposed to engagement measurement.

doubleOptInEnabled.description: Whether new contacts must confirm by email before they become subscribed. When on, contacts added by forms, the API, and integrations start pending and are never sent marketing email until they confirm.

doubleOptInEmailId.description: Confirmation email sent to pending contacts. Null when double opt-in has never been enabled; enabling it provisions one automatically.

doubleOptInRedirectUrl.description: Where the hosted confirmation page sends subscribers after they confirm. Null keeps them on the branded confirmation page.

trackingDomain.description: Company tracking domain, used by every sending domain for tracked links and opens. Null when links use the shared Sequenzy tracking domain; links also use it while the tracking domain is not verified. Manage it with the Tracking Domain endpoints.

targetLists.description: Saved campaign audience, or null when targeting is still unset and scheduling will fall back to all active subscribers.

ccEmails.description: Addresses CC'd on every recipient's email for this campaign.

bccEmails.description: Addresses BCC'd on every recipient's email for this campaign.

shareUrl.description: Public anonymized view-in-browser link, or null until one is minted via POST /campaigns/{campaignId}/share-link.

blocks.description: Blocks render in slot order: top, hero, form, body, footer, preserving order within each slot. Includes nested group children. An empty array is accepted: a default footer is appended whenever no footer is present. The stored document has exactly one footer.

LandingPageContent.description: Version 2 landing page builder document. Providing content on update replaces the whole document. Block IDs must be unique throughout the tree. A missing footer is appended automatically; after normalization exactly one footer and at most one form are allowed. Groups may nest at most eight levels, and every child must share its parent slot. See /api-reference/landing-pages/content for block examples and semantic validation. Form and footer blocks must stay at the root, outside groups.

text.description: Plain text or inline HTML (bold, italic, links, colors). At most 80 visible characters; formatting markup does not count toward that limit.

LandingPageButtonBlock.description: CTA url accepts an HTTPS URL or an in-page anchor such as #form, #section-<sectionId>, #block-<blockId>, or #top. Anchor links open in the same tab.

customFields.description: Up to eight custom subscriber attributes. Names use letters, numbers, underscores, dots or dashes and must start with a letter. Use unique names; email, firstName, lastName and website are reserved.

LandingPageFormConfig.description: Form audience and submission settings. listMode default uses the workspace default lists; none joins no lists; specific uses listIds. All listIds and tagIds must belong to your company. Custom field names must be unique and cannot be email, firstName, lastName or website. Redirect URLs must pass HTTP/HTTPS validation.

LandingPageGroupBlock.description: Children share the parent slot. Overlay needs exactly one direct image block with at most one gallery image; other overlay groups normalize to stack. Maximum group depth is eight.

content.description: Plain text or inline HTML (bold, italic, links, colors). At most 180 visible characters; formatting markup does not count toward that limit.

LandingPagePricingBlock.description: Pricing buttonUrl accepts an HTTPS URL or an in-page anchor such as #form.

faviconUrl.description: Empty falls back to the company logo.

hideFromSearchEngines.description: Adds noindex, nofollow. The page stays reachable by direct link.

content.description: Plain text or inline HTML (bold, italic, links, colors). At most 700 visible characters; formatting markup does not count toward that limit.

sectionAnimation.description: Scroll reveal animation; skipped for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

LandingPageVideoBlock.description: Embeds a YouTube share URL. Other video providers and direct video files are not supported.

title.description: Inline HTML is sanitized. Visible text after stripping markup and trimming must contain at most 120 characters. maxLength limits the raw markup separately.

description.description: Inline HTML is sanitized. Visible text after stripping markup and trimming must contain at most 300 characters. maxLength limits the raw markup separately.

CaptureFeature.description: At least one of title or description must contain visible text.

content.description: Inline HTML is sanitized. Visible text after stripping markup and trimming must contain 1 to 180 characters. maxLength limits the raw markup separately.

quote.description: Inline HTML is sanitized. Visible text after stripping markup and trimming must contain 1 to 500 characters. maxLength limits the raw markup separately.

content.description: Inline HTML is sanitized. Visible text after stripping markup and trimming must contain at most 700 characters. maxLength limits the raw markup separately.

FormCaptureBlock.description: Form content block, selected by kind. Returned content includes normalized defaults.

message.default: Something went wrong. Please try again.

FormCaptureFieldOption.description: Choice option. Supply value; id and label are derived from it when omitted. Read responses include the normalized id and label.

resubscribeBehavior.description: What happens when a contact who unsubscribed from all email submits the form or popup again. `reactivate` resubscribes them and restores the target lists. `double_opt_in` sends the workspace confirmation email first. Workspace double opt-in always requires confirmation.

botProtection.description: Whether a Cloudflare Turnstile bot check runs before each signup. Signups that fail it confirm by email first.

heading.description: Inline HTML is sanitized. Visible text after stripping markup and trimming must contain at most 120 characters. maxLength limits the raw markup separately.

message.description: Inline HTML is sanitized. Visible text after stripping markup and trimming must contain 1 to 240 characters. maxLength limits the raw markup separately.

SavedFormContent.description: Complete version 1 form builder document. Read content.blocks before replacing the array. Exactly one required email field and one submit button are required. Block IDs and field names must be unique. At most 200 total blocks and three levels of groups. See /api-reference/widgets/update-saved-form#content-blocks for writable fields and placement rules. Read responses include template, theme, settings and all defaulted properties after normalization.

resubscribeBehavior.description: What happens when a contact who unsubscribed from all email submits the form or popup again. `reactivate` resubscribes them and restores the target lists. `double_opt_in` sends the workspace confirmation email first. Workspace double opt-in always requires confirmation.

botProtection.description: Whether a Cloudflare Turnstile bot check runs before each signup. Signups that fail it confirm by email first.

errorMessage.default: Something went wrong. Please try again.

items.description: Built-in field name (firstName, lastName, email) or custom:<fieldId>.

publishedAt.description: Publication timestamp; unpublishing may preserve it. Use status to determine whether the form is currently published.

url.description: Dashboard URL for this form.
Dashboard edit URL.

customDomain.description: Preferred verified custom hostname for this page.

customDomainScope.description: Whether the preferred hostname is dedicated to this page or inherited from the workspace.

publicUrl.description: Custom-domain public URL when a verified custom domain is connected, otherwise the Sequenzy-hosted public URL.

previewUrl.description: Signed, unlisted visitor-facing preview of the current content. Works for drafts. Not indexed.

landingPageId.description: Assigned landing page ID for a dedicated page domain.

fallbackDomain.description: Verified or pending workspace domain retained as a fallback for a page-scoped domain.

fallbackDomainStatus.description: Workspace fallback-domain status; `not_started` when no fallback domain is configured.

dnsRecordType.description: DNS record type to add - CNAME for subdomains, A for root domains.

dnsRecordName.description: DNS record name (the connected hostname); null when no domain is connected.

dnsRecordValue.description: DNS record value - the CNAME target for subdomains or the A record IP (76.76.21.21) for root domains.

labels.description: Label names assigned to this template.

isTemplate.description:
True when this email is marked as a reusable master design.
Master designs are offered first when a sequence step or campaign
starts from an existing email, and starting from one always creates
an independent copy (never a shared link).

shareUrl.description:
Public anonymized view-in-browser URL. Null until a link is
minted via POST /templates/{templateId}/share-link.

abTests.description:
Present when this email belongs to one or more A/B test
variants and the key has ab_tests:read. Content edits must use
the A/B variant update endpoint / `update_ab_test_variant`
tool, not PUT /templates/{templateId}. Campaign variants can
share one email, so each test lists every matching variant.

allOf.description:
Validation error. When code is AB_TEST_VARIANT_CONTENT_EDIT, the
recovery fields below are present. abTests is included only when
the key also has ab_tests:read.

editedAt.description: When this translation was last edited in the dashboard or stored with keepEdits. Automatic translation on save keeps edited translations and marks them stale when the original changes. Null otherwise.

EmailClientBreakdown.description: Mail client and device shares of unique opens. Each email send counts once, attributed to the user agent of its first open. Opens through the Gmail and Yahoo image proxies and Apple Mail Privacy Protection report the client with an unknown device.

totalOpens.description: Unique opens the breakdown covers. `0` when nothing was opened, in which case `clients` and `devices` are empty.

privacyProxyOpens.description: Opens through the Gmail or Yahoo image proxies or Apple Mail Privacy Protection, where the reader's device is unknown.

key.description: `android_mail_app` covers Android apps that render mail in a WebView, such as Samsung Email. `web_browser` covers webmail, the new Outlook for Windows, and opens recorded from a link click without a tracked open. `apple_mail` also includes some apps built on Apple's WebKit, such as Outlook for Mac. `other` covers unrecognized and missing user agents.

share.description: Percentage of `totalOpens`, from 0 to 100. Not rounded.
Percentage of `totalOpens`, from 0 to 100. Not rounded.

ABTestSignificance.description: Statistical significance of the test's winner metric. The leading variant is compared with every other variant using a two-sided two-proportion z-test, Bonferroni-corrected for the number of comparisons. Rates are measured over delivered emails, or sends when no deliveries were recorded. Before a winner is selected it uses the same time range as the stats. Once a winner is selected, it compares only emails sent before the winner was chosen (with all of their later opens and clicks) and ignores period, start and end, because the winner's later sends are counted under its variant.

metric.description: Metric compared, taken from the test's winner criteria.

status.description: `insufficient_data` means a variant has fewer than 30 recipients or too few opens/clicks (or non-conversions) for a reliable result. `significant` means confidence reached `confidenceLevel`.

leaderVariantId.description: Variant with the highest rate, or null when the top variants are tied.

confidence.description: One minus the corrected p-value, from 0 to 1. Values at or above confidenceLevel mean the difference is unlikely to be chance. Very strong results can round to exactly 1. Null while data is insufficient.

pValue.description: Corrected two-sided p-value of the weakest leader comparison. Very strong results can round to exactly 0. Null while data is insufficient.

relativeLift.description: Relative improvement of the leader over the closest variant (0.3 means 30% higher). Null without a leader or when the closest variant has no opens/clicks.

kind.description: Identifies which settings model applies to this test.

testPercentage.description: Campaign test audience percentage. Sequence tests retain the legacy internal sentinel value 100; use settings instead.

testDurationMinutes.description: Campaign test duration. Sequence tests retain the legacy internal sentinel value 0; use settings instead.

testType.description: Effective sequence variant strategy. Present for sequence tests.

winnerThreshold.description: Effective sequence recipient threshold. Present for sequence tests.

autoSelectWinner.description: Whether a winner is picked automatically once winnerThreshold is reached and one variant leads. False after testing is resumed; contacts are then split until a winner is selected. Present for sequence tests.

settings.description: Effective settings for this test kind. Campaign tests return testPercentage, testDurationMinutes, and winnerCriteria; sequence tests return testType, winnerThreshold, and winnerCriteria.

pendingSampleUpdate.description: Durable campaign sample request, null when absent or applied. Retry the same testPercentage after an interrupted request; error enables explicit discard.

progress.description: Present on campaign detail and settings responses. Null if the campaign is missing. Counts unique recipient deliveries across retry attempts, excluding separate test emails.

audienceSize.description: Original send-time audience size; null for legacy campaigns without an estimate.

committed.description: Recipients with a durable send attempt, including pending or failed sends.

sent.description: Recipients with a sentAt timestamp on an attempt.

remaining.description: Audience size minus committed recipients, floored at zero; null when size is unavailable.

minimumTestPercentage.description: Minimum whole percentage that contains committed recipients, at least 5; null without audience size. Workers revalidate against later sends.

failed.description: Recipients with failed attempts and no successful or pending attempt.

Account.description: A B2B account (organization, workspace or team) that contacts belong to.

externalId.description: Customer-owned organization ID, unique per workspace.

attributes.description: Account attributes, fanned out to members as `account.<name>`.

domain.description: Normalized to a hostname such as acme.com.

attributes.description: Up to 100 attributes. Null values delete keys when merging.

propertyKey.description: Event property or contact attribute holding your organization ID, such as `workspaceId`. Trimmed.

nameKey.description: Property or attribute holding the organization name. Without it, accounts are named after the work email domain their contacts share.
Sibling property with the organization name, when found.

eventCount.description: Events carrying the key (`event`) or contacts with the attribute (`attribute`).

accountCount.description: Distinct organizations, the accounts creating would make.

eventNames.description: Up to 8 event names carrying the key. Empty for attributes.

externalId.description: The organization ID, which becomes the account's external ID.

name.description: The name the account gets. From `nameKey` when set, otherwise from the work email domain most of its contacts share. Null when neither exists.

domain.description: Work email domain most of its contacts share. Personal and disposable providers and your own sending domains are ignored.

sampleEmails.description: Up to 3 of those contacts, those at `domain` first.

settings.description: What the run reads. A run already in progress for the same `propertyKey` keeps its own `source` and `nameKey`, which may differ from a later request.

accountsUpdated.description: Existing accounts that got a name or domain.

skipped.description: Contacts that no longer exist, or invalid IDs.

truncated.description: History was larger than one run covers. Start the job again to continue.

name.description: Name the account gets when the suggestion is accepted.

contactCount.description: Contacts at the domain. Domains with any contact in an account are not suggested.

sampleEmails.description: Up to 10 of those contacts' emails, alphabetical, so you can check who is behind the suggestion.

contactCount.description: Eligible contacts at the domain (in no account, or already in this one), before the 5,000 member cap.

truncated.description: True when contacts were left out because accounts hold at most 5,000 members (the attribute fan-out limit).

email.description: Null for phone-only (SMS) contacts, which are identified by their phone number instead.

externalId.description: Customer-owned app/customer/user ID for this subscriber

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier used for recipient-local campaign delivery. Null when unknown.

smsStatus.description: SMS marketing consent status, independent of the email status

unsubscribedAt.description: When the contact opted out, derived from the list memberships the opt-out deactivated. Use this rather than `updatedAt` to date an opt-out - any later tag or attribute write moves `updatedAt`. Null unless the contact is currently unsubscribed, so leaving a single list does not set it, and null for contacts imported as already unsubscribed, where no date exists.

phoneCountry.description: Two-letter ISO country code associated with the normalized phone number, or null when unavailable.

SubscriberImportRecord.description: Every record must include an email or a phone. Records with only a phone import as phone-only (SMS) contacts.

email.description: Optional when the record has a phone.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. America/New_York) used for recipient-local campaign delivery. Records with an invalid value import without it.

phone.description: Phone number. National-format values use the batch defaultPhoneCountry. Required when the record has no email.

status.description: Email status from the source platform. Unsubscribed and bounced records are stored with that status, never enroll in sequences and never receive a double opt-in confirmation, whatever optInMode is. An active record never resubscribes an existing unsubscribed or bounced contact. With merge or overwrite, an unsubscribed or bounced record applies that status to an existing active contact; an unsubscribe also stamps its list memberships and cancels its running sequences. With skip, existing contacts are left unchanged.

createdAt.description: Original signup date on the source platform. Preserves the contact's real history so date-relative segments are correct right after the import. An existing contact's date only ever moves earlier. An unusable value rejects the whole request with a 400 naming the row.

skippedReasons.description: Count per reason a row was skipped. The values sum to skippedCount.

isPrivate.description: Whether the list is private. Private lists are omitted from the hosted subscriber email preferences/unsubscribe page and cannot be subscribed to or unsubscribed from individually there. List privacy does not override a subscriber's global unsubscribe.

eventType.description: Email event type (send, delivery, open, click, bounce, complaint, unsubscribe, delivery_delay), "custom" for subscriber events, or an SMS event type (sms_sent, sms_delivered, sms_failed, sms_clicked, sms_opted_out). New types may be added over time.

machine.description: Whether this open/click event is classified as bot/scanner activity.

classificationReasons.description: Classification reason codes for open/click events.

smsSendId.description: SMS send this event belongs to. Present only on sms_* events.

smsErrorCode.description: Carrier or provider error code. Present only on sms_failed events.

smsSegments.description: Number of SMS segments the message was split into. Present only on sms_* events.

kind.description: Required when the filter is inside a v2 root group.

operator.description: Valid operators depend on the field. status/segment: is, is_not. smsStatus: is, is_not (values: subscribed, unsubscribed, not_subscribed). phone: is_not_empty, is_empty (empty value). tag: contains, not_contains, is_empty, is_not_empty. email: contains, not_contains for domain or substring matching, is, is_not for an exact case-insensitive address. emailProvider/list: is, is_not, is_empty, is_not_empty. firstName/lastName: contains, not_contains, is_empty, is_not_empty. added: less_than, more_than. attribute: is, is_not, is_empty, is_not_empty, gte, lte, gt, lt, contains, not_contains. event and email engagement fields: is, is_not, at_least, less_than_count. emailBounced also supports is_temporary_bounce and is_permanent_bounce. stripeProduct: is, is_not, at_least, less_than_count. stripeCurrentProduct/stripeTrialProduct: is, is_not, gte, lte, gt, lt. commerceProduct/commerceCollection: is, is_not, at_least, less_than_count. pushDevice: is, is_not (values: any, web, ios, android; matches active push devices). pushSent/pushDelivered/pushClicked: is, is_not with a time range such as 30d or all (test sends are ignored).

value.description: Event filters use `eventName:30d` or `eventName:5:30d`. Segment filters use a segment ID. Email engagement fields use a rolling time window (`7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `180d`, `all`), a specific campaign via `campaign:<campaign_id>`, an email-type scope via `marketing:<timeRange>` (marketing-policy campaign, automation, and Send API traffic) or `transactional:<timeRange>` (transactional-policy sends; with is/is_not or the emailBounced subtype operators; scopes require a send-time policy snapshot, so ambiguous older events remain unscoped), or `count:timeRange` (such as `10:30d` or `10:all`) with at_least/less_than_count. Stripe product filters use `prod_123` for bought/current/trialing checks, `prod_123:3` for payment thresholds, and product-scoped values such as `prod_123:is_canceled`, `prod_123:cancels_at:2026-05-26`, `prod_123:end_at:2026-05-26`, or `prod_123:start_at:7 days ago`. Commerce product filters use `provider:productId` (provider one of `shopify`, `woocommerce`, `api`), optionally with an order-count threshold (`shopify:42:2`); a bare product ID matches the ID on any provider. Commerce collection filters use a collection ID or handle (`skincare`), optionally provider-prefixed and/or with an order-count threshold (`shopify:skincare:2`), and match anyone whose orders contain any product currently in that collection. Push device filters use `any`, `web`, `ios`, or `android`. Push sent, delivered, and clicked filters use a time range (`7d`, `30d`, `all`).

filters.description: Legacy v1 flat filters, or flattened leaves for v2 responses.

DataExport.description: A bucket that Sequenzy streams workspace data to as gzipped JSON lines.

accessKeyId.description: Masked access key ID, for example AKIA…WXYZ. The secret is never returned.

status.description: failed means the last run failed; it retries automatically with backoff.

exportedThrough.description: Per dataset. Event datasets: everything recorded up to this timestamp has been written. subscribers: date of the last complete snapshot. null until the first export of that dataset.

stats.description: Per-dataset rows, files, bytes and the window exported.

config.description: Non-secret settings. BigQuery also includes serviceAccountEmail.

rowsUnchanged.description: Rows skipped because they did not change since they were last sent.

rowsSkipped.description: Rows missing required values, or events for unknown contacts. Read again when the row changes, on a full resync, or on every run without a cursor column.

rowsFailed.description: Rows Sequenzy could not write this time. The cursor stays at the first of them, so the next run reads them again.

imports.description: Progress of the subscriber imports this run queued.

cursorValue.description: Rows with the cursor column at or after this value are read next.

syncStatus.description: idle, syncing, error, or disconnected (the Meta connection was revoked; the sync is paused until you reconnect)

lastSyncedCount.description: Subscribers uploaded in the most recent run.

ProductDigitalDelivery.description: Distributable file delivered after a purchase of this product.

inStock.description: For Stripe products, false means archived in Stripe.

SubscriberListPagination.description: Pagination for the subscriber list endpoint. `total` and `totalPages` are null on cursor requests because the count query is skipped.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Null when there are no further results.

labels.description: Assigned company label names. Empty when unlabelled.

managedBy.description: `code` when the email was created by a direct-content send with `trackAs`. Its content is a snapshot of a recent send, it cannot be sent by slug, and only `name`, `enabled` and `labels` can be updated. `dashboard` for every other transactional email.

filename.description: The filename for the attachment (including extension)

content.description: Base64-encoded file content (mutually exclusive with path)

path.description: URL to fetch the file from (mutually exclusive with content)

contentType.description: MIME type of the attachment (optional, auto-detected from the filename if not provided)

contentId.description: Content-ID that embeds the file as an inline image instead of attaching it. Reference it from the HTML body as ``; the message is then sent as multipart/related, which is the only embedded-image form Gmail renders. If nothing in the HTML references the value, the file is sent as a normal attachment.

UrlAttachment.description: URL-backed email attachment. The file is fetched from the URL at send time (max 10 attachments and 15MB total per email). For event-triggered sequences, path may be an event merge tag such as {{event.file_url}} that resolves to a public URL for each enrollment. Base64 content is not supported here.

filename.description: Filename shown in the recipient's email client (including extension). Event merge tags are supported.

path.description: Public HTTP(S) URL or an event-backed URL template such as {{event.file_url}}. The resolved URL is validated and fetched at send time.

EmailBlockTypeReference.description: Field reference for one email block type. Lists are their own block type rather than a text variant: a `text` block accepts only variant paragraph, lead, or html and never accepts `items`.

creatable.description: False for structural types the editor manages, which should not be hand-authored.

reason.description: Why a non-creatable type is excluded.

example.description: A minimal valid block of this type.

EmailBlockConditionFieldReference.description: One field a block condition may filter on. A block's own `field` and `operator` entries are two flat enums that pool every field's operators together, and the schema narrows them against each other when it validates - so `{"field": "tag", "operator": "is"}` parses and is then rejected. This is that narrowing, spelled out.

operators.description: The only operators this field accepts.

values.description: Closed value set, for the fields that have one.

valueFormat.description: How the `value` string is shaped for this field.

serverEvaluated.description: Whether the field reads stored subscriber state rather than the merge data of the send.

previewSupport.description: What a render needs before it can evaluate this field. any_contact - resolved from merge data. inline_tags_or_stored_subscriber - tag, which an inline contact can state for itself. stored_subscriber - needs subscriberId. A condition a render cannot evaluate renders as false and is listed in that render's unevaluatedConditions.

example.description: A valid condition using this field.

type.description: Value shape, for example string, number, boolean, enum, array, or object.

values.description: Allowed values, for enum and literal-union fields.

itemFields.description: Shape of one entry in an array field. This is where `list` and `steps` differ: list items carry `content`, steps items carry `title` and an optional `description`.

fields.description: Shape of an object field, for example the `mode`, `strategy`, `lookbackDays`, `sort`, and `filters` of a repeat block's `productSource`.

EmailBlock.description: Email content block. The shape depends on the block type. Any block may carry a `conditions` array so it renders only for matching recipients, the structural `group` type wraps children in Stack, Row, Grid, or Overlay layout, and `conditional-group` adds if/else branching via `ifBranch` and `elseBranch` (each an object with a `children` array).

content.description: Content for text, html, and heading-like blocks.

label.description: Editor label for a structural group block.

layout.description: Direct-child layout for a structural group block.

columns.description: Number of columns used by a group with grid layout.

gap.description: Gap in pixels between direct group children.

stackOnMobile.description: Columns block only. Multi-column rows stack into a single column on screens 480px wide or narrower. Set to false to keep the columns side by side on mobile. Omit or set to true for the default stacking.

padding.description: Uniform group padding in pixels; per-side styles.padding* fields override it.

overlayColor.description: Opaque fallback and shade color for an overlay group.

overlayShade.description: Overlay shade intensity as a percentage.

overlayPosition.description: Vertical position of overlay foreground content.

children.description: Recursive child blocks for group and repeat containers.

styles.description: Per-block visual styles. For compatibility, style fields such as backgroundColor, backgroundOpacity, borderColor, borderWidth, and borderRadius can also be supplied at the block top level and are normalized into this object.

bleed.description: Stretch the block edge-to-edge across the email container. Top-level blocks only.

conditions.description: Optional per-block display rules. The block renders only when every rule matches. The same shape is used for a conditional-group block's top-level `conditions`.

field.description: `variable` resolves a merge-tag path from the transactional send `variables` or an automation `event` payload (nested paths like `order.total` or `event.plan` work). `attribute` reads a stored subscriber attribute. `email`, `firstName`, and `lastName` read core subscriber fields.

value.description: For `variable` and `attribute`, use `name:value` - the part before the colon is the variable path or attribute name, and the part after it is the comparison value. For `email`, `firstName`, and `lastName`, provide the plain comparison string.

token.description: Pass as previewToken with identical input when applying. Relevant content changes invalidate it.

defaultSlot.description: Slot this component is pinned as the company default for, or null when it is an ordinary saved component.

version.description: Incremented every time the component's blocks are replaced. Emails cloned from an earlier version keep those blocks.

emailType.description: Send-source category retained for analytics compatibility. Use deliveryPolicy for the actual marketing or transactional policy.

deliveryPolicy.description: Delivery policy used for suppression and compliance behavior, or null when retained legacy events cannot prove it.

type.description: Send-source category. API/MCP sends use transactional here even when their delivery policy is marketing.

emailType.description: Delivery policy used for suppression and compliance behavior, or null when retained legacy data cannot prove it.

isTransactional.description: Stored delivery-policy snapshot. Prefer emailType for a normalized value.

isTestEmail.description: Whether this delivery was a test send hidden from normal sent-email history.

subscriberExternalId.description: Customer-owned subscriber ID captured from a single-recipient transactional send.

additionalRecipients.description: Full recipient envelope for multi-recipient transactional sends, as actually sent. Null for single-recipient sends.

originalReplyTo.description: Resolved reply destination, optionally including a display name. When reply tracking is disabled, this is the sent Reply-To header. When reply tracking is enabled, the sent header is a unique trackable address and this value is the forwarding destination.

internalFailureCode.description: Why a send reached status "failed". Present only for terminal delivery failures. "transport_exhausted" means every available delivery route was refused by the recipient provider; "admin_bounce" means an operator removed the message from the delivery queue; "crash_orphaned_claim" means the sending worker stopped between claiming the send and recording a transport outcome, so the message was never confirmed as reaching the provider. None of them is a bounce: the address is still valid, stays subscribed, and is not suppressed. New codes can be added over time, so treat an unrecognized value as a generic failure rather than rejecting the response.

emailBody.description: Stored HTML body. Null when the email send row has been cleaned up.

isCopiedRecipient.description: Whether this is an auxiliary CC/BCC delivery record whose content and engagement belong to a primary email send.

primaryEmailSendId.description: Primary email send ID for a copied-recipient delivery, or null for ordinary sends and when the primary record is unavailable.

html.description: Raw HTML body. Provide either html or blocks, not both.

blocks.description: Structured email blocks. Provide either blocks or html, not both. Put visual styling under styles; top-level style keys such as backgroundColor, backgroundOpacity, borderColor, borderWidth, and borderRadius are normalized into styles.

BlockFieldWarnings.description: Non-blocking advisories about a successful write. Present when an input was discarded or did not take effect as requested. This includes block fields that do not render as their names suggest, sequence email-step formatting restored on top of submitted blocks, and sender-identity conflicts such as a replyToName that differs from the saved profile. Each message identifies the affected input and gives recovery guidance. Absent when there is nothing to report.
example: blocks[0].styles.color is not a supported field and was ignored. Button label color comes from the block-level `buttonTextColor` field. Supported styles fields: backgroundColor, backgroundOpacity, bleed, borderColor, borderRadius, borderWidth, paddingBottom, paddingLeft, paddingRight, paddingTop, textAlign, textColor.

SequenceStatus.description: Stored lifecycle status. Do not read literally: a sequence can be active while enrollmentPaused blocks new subscribers. Branch on effectiveStatus instead.

SequenceEffectiveStatus.description: Resolved run state, and the single field to branch on. live accepts new subscribers and advances existing recipients; enrollment_paused advances existing recipients only; draft, paused, and archived do neither.

SequenceTriggerType.description: How contacts enter the sequence. `segment_exited` enrolls active contacts who stop matching the segment; unsubscribing or bouncing does not count as leaving. `manual` never enrolls anyone automatically; use it with key dates for one-time countdown campaigns and enroll the audience with the enroll-audience endpoint.

SequenceDelayInput.description: Delay before this step runs. Use duration fields for fixed waits, mode until_date with untilDateField for a date from the trigger event or a contact attribute (untilDateSource), mode until_weekday with the weekday window fields, or mode until_key_date with untilKeyDate (prefer the waitUntilKeyDate shorthand).

untilKeyDate.description: Key of a sequence key date to wait relative to when mode is until_key_date.

untilPastAction.description: For until_key_date and until_date, what a late enrollee does when the moment already passed. continue moves on immediately, skip skips the following email and action steps until the next wait, condition or branch, exit ends the enrollment. Defaults to skip for until_key_date and continue for until_date.

untilDateField.description: Date field path to wait until when mode is until_date, read from the source chosen by untilDateSource.

untilDateSource.description: Where untilDateField is read from when mode is until_date. event reads the trigger event properties; attribute reads the contact's custom attributes when the step is reached. Defaults to event.

untilOffsetDirection.description: Whether the offset runs before or after the date field. Defaults to after.

untilMissingAction.description: What to do when the date field is missing or invalid. Defaults to continue.

untilDays.description: Weekdays the wait may release on when mode is until_weekday.

untilStartTime.description: Window start in 24-hour HH:mm local time when mode is until_weekday.

untilEndTime.description: Window end in 24-hour HH:mm local time when mode is until_weekday. Defaults to the end-of-day boundary 24:00.

untilTimezone.description: IANA timezone used to evaluate the window when mode is until_weekday.

SequenceWaitUntilInput.description: Wait until a date from the trigger event or a contact attribute, optionally offset before or after that date. The value must be an ISO 8601 date or a Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds.

field.description: Date field path to wait until, read from the source.

source.description: Where field is read from. event reads the trigger event properties and needs an event trigger. attribute reads the contact's custom attributes when the step is reached, so it works with any trigger. If the date moves later while a contact is waiting, the contact waits for the new date; moving it earlier does not release them sooner, and a date removed while waiting follows missingAction. Defaults to event.

days.description: Shorthand offset days when offset is omitted.

hours.description: Shorthand offset hours when offset is omitted.

minutes.description: Shorthand offset minutes when offset is omitted.

direction.description: Whether the offset runs before or after the field date. Defaults to after.

missingAction.description: What to do when the date field is missing or invalid. Defaults to continue.

pastAction.description: What to do when the date, after the offset, already passed when the contact reaches this wait. continue moves on immediately, skip skips the following email and action steps until the next wait, condition or branch so late joiners only get what is still ahead, exit ends the enrollment. Defaults to continue.

key.description: Stable identifier referenced by waitUntilKeyDate.key (lowercase letters, digits, underscores). Defaults to a slug of the label.

label.description: Human label shown in the builder.

at.description: ISO 8601 date-time. A value without a zone designator ("2026-11-27T00:00") is read as wall-clock time in the key dates timezone. Stored and returned normalized to UTC.

SequenceKeyDates.description: Named absolute moments the sequence counts down to. Delay steps with waitUntilKeyDate wait relative to one of them, so the whole countdown is re-timed by editing these dates. Changing a key date on a live sequence re-schedules contacts already waiting on it. Send null to clear.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the dates are shown and edited in. Required when dates is non-empty.

SequenceWaitUntilKeyDateInput.description: Wait relative to one of the sequence's key dates before this step, e.g. 7 days before black_friday_starts or 1 hour before black_friday_ends. The key must exist in the sequence's keyDates.

days.description: Offset days shorthand. Ignored when offset is provided.

direction.description: Whether the offset applies before or after the key date. Defaults to before.

pastAction.description: What a late enrollee does when the moment already passed. skip (default) skips the following steps until the next wait, continue sends immediately, exit ends the enrollment.

missingAction.description: What to do when the key date no longer exists. Defaults to exit.

SequenceAudience.description: Who to enroll. Same shape as campaign targetLists.

include.description: For type rules; include rules of type all, lists, segments, or filtered.

data.description: Run-level data passed when the run was started, read by the run's emails as `{{enrollment.<field>}}`. Null when none was given.

estimatedCount.description: Audience size estimated when the run started.

skippedCount.description: Matching contacts skipped because they were already in the sequence (or, for one_time sequences, finished it before).

scheduledFor.description: Delayed start. While set and in the future the run stays queued; cancel it before then to prevent the enrollment.

SequenceAudienceAutoEnroll.description: Manual countdowns only. Keeps enrolling people who join the audience later (new list members, new segment matches) until the last key date passes; they land on the step the countdown is at. Switching on enrolls the current audience right away and re-checks every few minutes. Ends itself after the last key date. Send null to clear.

enabled.description: Defaults to true. False keeps the audience but stops syncing.

startsAt.description: No sync runs before this moment. Pass the scheduledFor of a scheduled initial enrollment so late joiners are not enrolled ahead of everyone else.

lastSyncedAt.description: Start time of the last successfully completed sync. Failed or cancelled runs do not advance it. Incremental scans include new or updated contacts and new list memberships.

SequenceWaitUntilWeekdayInput.description: Hold until the next occurrence of a weekday inside a local-time window. Contacts already inside the window continue immediately.

day.description: Single weekday convenience alias for days.

days.description: Weekdays the wait may release on.

startTime.description: Window start in 24-hour HH:mm local time.

endTime.description: Window end in 24-hour HH:mm local time. Defaults to the end-of-day boundary 24:00.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to evaluate the window.

SequenceDiscountInput.description: Discount configuration for dynamic create_discount steps.

provider.description: Discount provider. Use stripe to dynamically create a Stripe coupon plus promotion code, or shopify to dynamically create a Shopify Admin discount code.

percentOff.description: Percent discount. Required when discountType is percent.

amountOff.description: Fixed discount amount in the smallest currency unit, for example 500 for $5. Required when discountType is amount.

currency.description: ISO currency for fixed-amount discounts. Defaults to usd.

appliesToAllPlans.description: Whether the discount applies to all plans. Defaults to true.

planIds.description: Provider product IDs when appliesToAllPlans is false. Stripe uses IDs like prod_abc123; Shopify accepts numeric product IDs or gid://shopify/Product/... IDs.

codePrefix.description: Optional prefix for generated dynamic codes. The final code also includes a subscriber/token suffix.

maxRedemptions.description: Maximum redemptions for each generated code. Use 1 for subscriber-specific codes.

lockToSubscriber.description: Stripe-only. Restrict each generated promotion code to the matched subscriber's Stripe customer.

expiresAt.description: Optional future expiration date or ISO timestamp. Mutually exclusive with expiresInHours.

expiresInHours.description: Optional relative expiration in hours, resolved when each subscriber's code is created. Takes precedence over expiresAt.

name.description: Optional display name for each dynamically generated provider discount.

type.description: Step type. Omit or use email for email content; use sms for a native SMS step; use push for a push notification step; use create_discount for a dynamic discount; use update_subscriber for an Update Subscriber action.

nodeType.description: Internal node-type alias for clients that work with automation nodes. Use action_update_attributes with config for Update Subscriber steps.

subject.description: Email subject line for email steps.

previewText.example: Here is what to do next

text.description: SMS steps only. Plain-text message body; merge tags like {{FIRST_NAME}} work. Do not include opt-out text or a brand prefix - Sequenzy adds both automatically at send time.

imageUrls.description: SMS steps only. Up to 2 publicly reachable image URLs sent as MMS media.

title.description: Push steps only. Notification title; merge tags work.

body.description: Push steps only. Notification message; merge tags work.

url.description: Push steps only. Link opened on tap - an https URL or an app deep link.

imageUrl.description: Push steps only. Optional https image.

iconUrl.description: Push steps only. Optional https web push icon.

platforms.description: Push steps only. Limit delivery to these platforms; omit for all.

ineligibleAction.description: SMS and push steps. skip (default) continues the sequence when the contact can't receive the message (SMS - no phone, no consent, unsupported country; push - no active device); exit removes them from the sequence.

blocks.description: Structured Sequenzy email blocks. Provide either blocks or html. Put visual styling under styles; top-level style keys such as backgroundColor, backgroundOpacity, borderColor, borderWidth, and borderRadius are normalized into styles.

html.description: Raw HTML preserved as one HTML block. Provide either html or blocks.

isTransactional.description: Send this email without the marketing unsubscribe footer.

senderProfileId.description: Existing sender profile override for this email step.

fromEmail.description: From address used to create a sender profile for this email step. Mutually exclusive with senderProfileId.

fromName.description: Display name override for this email step. Alone it only changes the visible name; with fromEmail it also names a newly created sender profile.

replyProfileId.description: Existing reply profile override for this email step.

replyTo.description: Reply-To address used to create a reply profile for this email step. Mutually exclusive with replyProfileId.

replyToName.description: Display name for the step reply profile. Requires replyTo; omit it when using replyProfileId, which already carries its own display name.

ccEmails.description: Addresses CC'd on this email step. Send an empty array to clear them.

bccEmails.description: Addresses BCC'd on this email step in addition to sequence-level BCC. Send an empty array to clear them.

attachments.description: URL-backed file attachments for this email step, fetched at send time. Event-triggered sequences may use {{event.*}} URL templates. Send an empty array to clear them.

delayMs.description: Delay before this step in milliseconds. Prefer delay for human-authored requests; use delayMs when importing provider waits.

name.description: Optional email template name for email steps.

discount.description: Discount configuration for create_discount steps. Prefer this nested shape for new integrations; legacy top-level discount fields are still accepted.

label.description: Legacy top-level builder label for discount steps. Prefer discount.label.

provider.description: Legacy top-level discount provider. Prefer discount.provider. Supports stripe and shopify.

discountType.description: Legacy top-level discount type. Prefer discount.discountType.

percentOff.description: Percent discount. Required when discountType is percent.

amountOff.description: Fixed discount amount in the smallest currency unit, for example 500 for $5. Required when discountType is amount.

currency.description: ISO currency for fixed-amount discounts. Defaults to usd.

appliesToAllPlans.description: Whether the discount applies to all plans. Defaults to true.

planIds.description: Provider product IDs when appliesToAllPlans is false. Stripe uses IDs like prod_abc123; Shopify accepts numeric product IDs or gid://shopify/Product/... IDs.

codePrefix.description: Optional prefix for generated dynamic codes. The final code also includes a subscriber/token suffix.

maxRedemptions.description: Maximum redemptions for each generated code. Use 1 for subscriber-specific codes.

lockToSubscriber.description: Legacy top-level Stripe-only flag. Prefer discount.lockToSubscriber.

expiresAt.description: Optional future expiration date or ISO timestamp. Mutually exclusive with expiresInHours.

expiresInHours.description: Optional relative expiration in hours, resolved when each subscriber's code is created. Takes precedence over expiresAt.

SequenceStopCondition.description: Auto-stop condition, re-evaluated before every step including the first one. has_tag, added_to_list, entered_segment, field_changed, and event_received stop the run once the thing happens. event_received only counts events received after enrollment - the enrolling event and earlier history never satisfy the stop. does_not_have_tag and removed_from_list stop the run whenever the subscriber lacks that tag or list membership, so they act as a required-tag or required-list allowlist and cancel everyone else before any step sends. Guarded-out contacts still enroll and are then cancelled at the trigger node, so they appear as cancellations there rather than in the active or waiting enrollment counts. Clearing the guard does not retry them: they only receive the sequence if the trigger fires for them again, and on the one_time enrollment mode not even then.

value.description: Tag name, list ID, segment ID, field path, or event name. For the does_not_have_tag and removed_from_list guards this is the tag or list a subscriber must have to keep receiving the sequence. Null with entry_audience matching means the tag or list that enrolled each contact is used.

matchConfig.description: Optional typed match rule. event_received uses event_property_filter propertyFilters (stop only when an event received after enrollment matches every filter, e.g. quota_used greater_than 1) or event_property rules (stop only when the stop event's field equals the same field captured on the enrolling event); field_changed uses a field_value comparison. Tag/list defaults use entry_audience to resolve the required tag or list per enrollment. Tag entry matching requires a tag_added trigger; list entry matching requires a contact_added trigger scoped to at least one specific list.

propertyFilters.description: Filters an event received after enrollment must all match for the stop to fire. Same shape as event trigger propertyFilters.

path.description: Dot-path into the stop event's properties.

value.description: Comparison value (string, number, or boolean; array of values for one_of). Omit for exists/not_exists.

audience.description: Use the tag or list recorded when this contact enrolled.

SequenceEnrollmentMode.description: Controls sequence re-entry. `unlimited` allows re-entry after completion but prevents concurrent active runs. `one_time` allows one enrollment ever. `matching_field` is only valid for event-triggered sequences and allows concurrent active runs only when the trigger payload resolves to a different event field value.

SequenceSendingWindow.description: Optional local-time sending window applied to every email step in a sequence. Email steps that become due outside the window wait until the next allowed local time.

startTime.description: Earliest local send time in 24-hour HH:mm format.

endTime.description: Latest local send cutoff in 24-hour HH:mm format, or 24:00 for the end-of-day boundary. Must be later than startTime.

days.description: Allowed local days. Omit days when creating or updating to allow every day.

path.description: Dot-path into the event properties. Use [] to match items inside arrays.

operator.description: Comparison operator. Value is required for every operator except exists and not_exists. `one_of` matches when the property equals any entry of the value array.

value.description: Value to compare against. For `one_of`, pass a non-empty array of strings or numbers (maximum 50 values); all other operators take a single value.

userCancellable.description: Whether recipients can cancel this sequence from email preferences.

labels.description: Dashboard label names. Missing labels are created.

bccEmails.description: Addresses blind-copied on every sequence email.

fromEmail.description: From address for every email in this sequence. Its domain must be configured and verified.

fromName.description: Display name recipients see, e.g. 'Brennon at TradeTally'. Selects the sender identity of that name on fromEmail, creating it when the address has no identity by that name; the mailbox's other display names, and everything pinned to them, are untouched. Requires fromEmail; omit it when using senderProfileId, which already carries its own display name.

senderProfileId.description: Existing sender profile ID. It already supplies both the From address and display name, so send it on its own and omit fromEmail and fromName. To keep this profile under a different display name, set fromName on the email steps instead, where it is a per-step override.

replyTo.description: Reply-To address for every email in this sequence. A profile is created when needed.

replyToName.description: Display name for the Reply-To address. Requires replyTo; omit it when using replyProfileId, which already carries its own display name. An address carries one Reply-To name company-wide, so if replyTo already has a saved profile under a different name, that saved name is kept and the response `warnings` array says so.

replyProfileId.description: Existing reply profile ID. It already supplies both the Reply-To address and display name, so send it on its own and omit replyTo and replyToName.

listId.description: List ID for contact_added triggers. Omit it to use listScope instead. Use listIds to trigger on several lists.

listIds.description: Several list IDs for a contact_added trigger. A contact joining ANY of them enrolls. Takes precedence over listId when both are sent. Cannot be combined with listScope.

listScope.description: For contact_added triggers with no list at all. `any_contact` (the default) enrolls every contact added, including contacts that join no list - which is what integrations create when list targeting is empty. `any_list` waits until the contact joins a list. Cannot be combined with listId or listIds.

tagName.description: Tag name for tag_added triggers. Use tagNames to trigger on several tags.

tagNames.description: Several tag names for a tag_added trigger. Receiving ANY of them enrolls the contact. Takes precedence over tagName when both are sent.

segmentId.description: Segment ID for segment_entered and segment_exited triggers.

stopOnSegmentExit.description: For segment_entered triggers, cancel enrollment when the subscriber leaves the segment.

eventName.description: Event name for event_received, inbound_webhook, inactivity, and frequency triggers.

integrationEventKey.description: Integration event key for inbound_webhook triggers.

propertyFilters.description: Event property filters for event_received and inbound_webhook triggers. The sequence only starts when the triggering event's properties match all filters. Use [] in the path to match items inside arrays.

inactiveDays.description: Days of inactivity before the sequence starts.

inactivityBaseline.description: For inactivity triggers, controls when to start counting for subscribers who have never performed the event. Defaults to sequence_created_at.

minCount.description: Minimum event count for frequency triggers.

timeWindowDays.description: Time window in days for frequency triggers.

enrollmentFieldPath.description: Scalar dot-path event property used by matching_field enrollment, such as order.id or product.providerVariantId. Array traversal with [] is not supported; use propertyFilters for array matching. Applies to event_received and inbound_webhook triggers. Leave empty for built-in Shopify product/variant defaults.

frequencyCapEnabled.description: Whether the sequence respects the company frequency cap (`/frequency-cap`). When true, an email step is skipped for a contact who already received the cap's number of campaign or marketing sequence emails in its window, and the contact continues to the next step. Transactional steps are never skipped and transactional emails never count. Has no effect until a cap is set.

keyDates.description: Named absolute moments for waitUntilKeyDate steps. Null clears them.

emailCount.description: Number of emails for AI-generated content. Defaults to 5. Maximum is 10.

durationDays.description: Total duration in days used to space AI-generated emails. Omit this to use the default sequence delay schedule.

emailStyle.description: Style for the AI-generated emails: visual (designed, with heroes/imagery/rich sections) or plain (personal, text-first notes with a single button). Defaults to the company's saved preference when omitted.

goal.description: Goal for AI-generated sequence content. Provide either goal or steps, or omit both for a blank dashboard-compatible draft.
goal.example: Welcome new users and help them reach activation.

steps.description: Explicit email and action steps. Provide either steps or goal, or omit both for a blank dashboard-compatible draft.

emailId.description: Email template ID to update. You can also pass the node ID here for compatibility.

nodeId.description: Sequence email node ID to update.

name.description: Updated step and email template name.

isTransactional.description: Use transactional email chrome for this sequence email.

attachments.description: URL-backed file attachments for this email step, fetched at send time. Event-triggered sequences may use {{event.*}} URL templates. Send an empty array to clear them.

emailPreset.description: Per-email Style > Format for native Sequenzy blocks, including emails that contain supported custom HTML blocks. Minimal removes the company logo and uses the simple footer; branded restores the branded chrome. This is not supported when the entire email is standalone raw HTML and must not be combined with html or htmlContent.

emailTheme.description: Theme override for this step's linked email only. Partial patch merged into the email's current theme; a step with no override merges into the company theme. Null drops the override.

blocks.description: Replacement Sequenzy email blocks. Put visual styling under styles; top-level style keys such as backgroundColor, backgroundOpacity, borderColor, borderWidth, and borderRadius are normalized into styles. Replacing blocks keeps that step's existing Style > Format rather than the company default: a step that already had a logo or a footer gets them back even when you omit them, and every block added that way is named in the response warnings array. Send emailPreset to change the format instead. A step stored as one standalone raw HTML block has no format, so replacing it with another standalone raw HTML block stores it exactly as sent and nothing is added; replacing that markup with native blocks is a conversion rather than a markup edit, so the new blocks do get a footer.

html.description: Raw HTML preserved as one HTML block. Provide html/htmlContent or blocks.

htmlContent.description: Alias for html. Raw HTML is preserved as one HTML block.

senderProfileId.description: Sender profile for this step's From identity. Overrides the sequence-level sender for this step. Mutually exclusive with fromEmail.

fromEmail.description: From address for this step. Its domain must be configured and verified. Mutually exclusive with senderProfileId.

fromName.description: Display name override for this step. Alone it only changes the visible name; with fromEmail it also names a newly created sender profile.

replyProfileId.description: Reply profile for this step's Reply-To. Mutually exclusive with replyTo.

replyTo.description: Reply-To address for this step. Mutually exclusive with replyProfileId.

replyToName.description: Reply-To display name override for this step. Requires replyTo; omit it when using replyProfileId, which already carries its own display name.

id.description: Optional stable branch ID. Defaults to branch-0, branch-1, etc.

conditionType.description: Condition for this path. Required on a condition split; must be omitted when the branch sets splitMode to random, where paths are chosen by percentage.

tagId.description: Tag ID or tag name for has_tag and does_not_have_tag conditions.

tagName.description: Tag name for has_tag and does_not_have_tag conditions.

segmentName.description: Optional display name for in_segment conditions.

linkUrl.description: Optional URL substring for link_clicked conditions. Omit to match any clicked link.

activityScope.description: Scope for event_received and link_clicked conditions.

fieldName.description: Subscriber attribute name for field conditions.

targetNodeId.description: Existing node reached by this branch path after any newly created steps. Use the completion node ID to end this path immediately.

steps.description: Optional steps to create in this branch path. When targetNodeId is also set, the final new step connects to that existing node.

SequenceBranchPathStepInput.description: Step created inside a sequence path.

type.description: Step type. Omit for email steps, use sms for a native SMS step, push for a push notification step, or use delay for a standalone wait.

nodeType.description: Advanced node type for non-email sequence path actions.

subject.description: Email subject. Required for email steps.

text.description: SMS steps only. Plain-text message body; merge tags like {{FIRST_NAME}} work.

imageUrls.description: SMS steps only. Up to 2 publicly reachable image URLs sent as MMS media.

title.description: Push steps only. Notification title; merge tags work.

body.description: Push steps only. Notification message; merge tags work.

url.description: Push steps only. Link opened on tap - an https URL or an app deep link.

imageUrl.description: Push steps only. Optional https image.

iconUrl.description: Push steps only. Optional https web push icon.

platforms.description: Push steps only. Limit delivery to these platforms; omit for all.

ineligibleAction.description: SMS and push steps. skip (default) continues the sequence when the contact can't receive the message (SMS - no phone, no consent, unsupported country; push - no active device); exit removes them from the sequence.

label.description: SMS steps only. Display label for the step in the builder.

blocks.description: Email blocks for email steps. Put visual styling under styles; top-level style keys such as backgroundColor, backgroundOpacity, borderColor, borderWidth, and borderRadius are normalized into styles.

delayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds. Useful for standalone delay steps.

name.description: Email template name for email steps.

senderProfileId.description: Email steps only. Sender profile for the new step. Omit to inherit the sender identity of the email step it is inserted after. Mutually exclusive with fromEmail.

fromEmail.description: Email steps only. From address for the new step; its domain must be verified. Mutually exclusive with senderProfileId.

fromName.description: Email steps only. Display name override for the new step. With fromEmail, also names a newly created sender profile.

replyProfileId.description: Email steps only. Reply profile for the new step. Omit to inherit from the preceding email step. Mutually exclusive with replyTo.

replyTo.description: Email steps only. Reply-To address for the new step. Mutually exclusive with replyProfileId.

replyToName.description: Email steps only. Reply-To display name override for this step. Requires replyTo; omit it when using replyProfileId, which already carries its own display name.

afterNodeId.description: Existing sequence node ID to insert the branch after.

splitMode.description: How subscribers are routed. condition evaluates each branch's conditionType in order. random assigns each subscriber a path by percentage when they reach the node, which runs a concurrent A/B test inside the sequence. A random split requires randomPercentages, omits conditionType and condition-specific fields on every branch, and has no else path.

randomPercentages.description: Required when splitMode is random. One non-negative percentage per entry in branches, in the same order, summing to 100.

branches.description: Branch paths. On a condition split they are evaluated in order and an else fallback is created automatically. On a random split each entry is a weighted variant. Each branch should include steps, targetNodeId, or both unless allowEmptyPaths is true.

elseSteps.description: Optional steps to create in the else fallback path. When elseTargetNodeId is also set, the final new step connects to that existing node. Rejected when splitMode is random.

elseTargetNodeId.description: Existing node reached by the else fallback path after any elseSteps. Use the original follow-up node to keep that path in the existing flow, or the completion node to end it. Rejected when splitMode is random.

allowEmptyPaths.description: Set true only when intentionally creating empty UI placeholders. Explicit target node paths do not require this flag.

afterNodeId.description: Existing sequence node ID to insert after. Omit only to append to an unambiguous linear tail.

steps.description: New linear steps to insert. Supports addable step types that do not require companion records; multi-path branches use the branch payload. Email steps require subject plus blocks or html. Inserted email steps inherit the effective identity of the nearest sequence email unless the step sets its own sender fields. After a branch merge, only identity fields shared by every incoming path are inherited; conflicting fields use sequence or company defaults.

condition.description: Exact branch-lane condition for this edge. Omit or set null for an unconditional edge.

expectedRevision.description: graphRevision from the latest get-sequence response. The update is rejected if the graph changed after it was read.

nodeId.description: Existing node to move, delete, or duplicate.

afterNodeId.description: Insert the moved or duplicated node immediately after this node. Mutually exclusive with beforeNodeId.

beforeNodeId.description: Insert the moved or duplicated node immediately before this node. Mutually exclusive with afterNodeId.

edges.description: Complete replacement topology for replace_edges. Also supported when deleting a split node whose continuation cannot be inferred safely.

EmailThemePatch.description: Partial visual theme patch. Omitted fields keep their current value, so {"colors": {"background": "#f3f4f6"}} repaints only the outer canvas, while content controls the inner card the blocks sit on. Colors are 6-digit hex; numeric values are clamped to their supported ranges. Null clears the stored theme.

content.description: Inner content card. Omit to preserve its current value; when no content color is stored, the card follows the outer canvas.

nodeId.description: Existing sequence node ID returned by get sequence.

changes.description: Type-aware node patch. Use the editableFields and notes from the node's updateHints. Omitted fields are preserved. For action_email nodes, a blocks patch that omits emailPreset never changes the step's format - see blocks on SequenceEmailUpdateInput.

emailPreset.description: For action_email nodes, set the linked email's per-email Style > Format. Native block emails may include supported custom HTML blocks. Not supported when the entire email is standalone raw HTML.

emailTheme.description: For action_email nodes, override this step's linked email theme only. The company default and every other email are untouched. The patch merges into the email's current theme, and a step with no override merges into the company theme rather than the platform preset. Send null to drop the override so the step follows the company theme again.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency token from the node's latest updatedAt or updateHints.expectedUpdatedAt value. MCP clients require this field.

userCancellable.description: Whether recipients can cancel this sequence from email preferences.

labels.description: Replacement dashboard label names. Missing labels are created.

fromEmail.description: From address for every email in this sequence. Its domain must be configured and verified.

fromName.description: Display name recipients see, e.g. 'Brennon at TradeTally'. Selects the sender identity of that name on fromEmail, creating it when the address has no identity by that name; the mailbox's other display names, and everything pinned to them, are untouched. Requires fromEmail; omit it when using senderProfileId, which already carries its own display name.

senderProfileId.description: Existing sender profile ID. It already supplies both the From address and display name, so send it on its own and omit fromEmail and fromName. To keep this profile under a different display name, set fromName on the email steps instead, where it is a per-step override.

replyTo.description: Reply-To address for every email in this sequence.

replyToName.description: Display name for the Reply-To address. Requires replyTo; omit it when using replyProfileId, which already carries its own display name. An address carries one Reply-To name company-wide, so if replyTo already has a saved profile under a different name, that saved name is kept and the response `warnings` array says so.

replyProfileId.description: Existing reply profile ID. It already supplies both the Reply-To address and display name, so send it on its own and omit replyTo and replyToName.

name.description: Updated sequence name.

trigger.description: Atomically replaces the current trigger. Include its typed configuration fields in the same request. Active sequences require confirmLiveChange.

listId.description: List ID for a replacement contact_added trigger.

listIds.description: Several list IDs for a replacement contact_added trigger. A contact joining ANY of them enrolls. Cannot be combined with listScope.

listScope.description: For a replacement contact_added trigger with no list. `any_contact` (the default) enrolls every contact added, even one that joins no list; `any_list` waits for a list membership. Cannot be combined with listId or listIds.

tagName.description: Tag name for a replacement tag_added trigger.

tagNames.description: Several tag names for a replacement tag_added trigger. Receiving ANY of them enrolls the contact.

segmentId.description: Segment ID for a replacement segment_entered or segment_exited trigger.

stopOnSegmentExit.description: Stop active enrollments when a contact leaves the replacement trigger segment.

eventName.description: Event name for event_received, inbound_webhook, inactivity, or frequency triggers.

integrationSlug.description: Catalog integration slug for an inbound_webhook trigger.

integrationEventKey.description: Catalog event key for an inbound_webhook trigger.

customIntegration.description: Custom integration descriptor for an inbound_webhook trigger.

enrollmentPaused.description: Set true to stop new enrollments for an active sequence while current recipients continue. Set false to resume new enrollments.

confirmStructuralChange.description: Required when inserting steps or branches, or editing the graph of an active sequence. Set true only after confirming the live-flow impact for current and future recipients.

confirmLiveChange.description: Required for trigger replacement or nodeUpdates on an active sequence. Set true only after confirming that the edits can affect recipients who reach those nodes in the future.

enrollmentFieldPath.description: Scalar dot-path event property used by matching_field enrollment on event_received and inbound_webhook sequences. Array traversal with [] is not supported; use propertyFilters for array matching. Set to null to use built-in defaults.

frequencyCapEnabled.description: Whether the sequence respects the company frequency cap (`/frequency-cap`). When true, an email step is skipped for a contact already at the cap, and the contact continues to the next step. Transactional steps are never skipped. Omit to leave it unchanged.

keyDates.description: Replace the sequence key dates. Contacts already waiting on a key-date step are re-scheduled to the new dates. Set to null to remove them (rejected while a step still waits for one).

audienceAutoEnroll.description: Keep enrolling later joiners of an audience until the last key date. Null clears it. Changing the trigger away from manual switches it off (endedReason "disabled").

bccEmails.description: Email addresses that receive a blind copy of every email this sequence sends, such as a customer support inbox (max 10). Set to null to remove them.

nodeUpdates.description: Atomic, type-aware patches for existing sequence nodes. A node may appear only once, and either every patch commits or none do.

emails.description: Existing email step updates. Provide either emails or steps. Items without nodeId or emailId are matched by existing step order and do not create new steps.

steps.description: Alias for emails. Use insertSteps to create new steps.

smsSteps.description: Content updates for existing SMS steps, targeted by action_sms nodeId. Content-only edits; use insertSteps to create new SMS steps.

subscriberUpdateSteps.description: Full config replacements for existing action_update_attributes steps, targeted by nodeId.

SubscriberUpdateConfig.description: Update Subscriber config. String values may use standalone trigger-event merge tags such as {{event.plan}}, {{event.amount}}, or {{event.active}}. Number and boolean values are coerced after resolution.

value.description: Literal scalar, null to delete, or one standalone merge tag.

SequencePathStepConfig.description: Config for advanced nodeType steps. Required fields depend on nodeType: action_add_tag and action_remove_tag need tagId or tagName; action_add_to_list and action_remove_from_list need listId; action_update_attributes uses the Update Subscriber fields and may reference the trigger event payload; logic_wait_for_event needs eventName plus optional timeoutDays and timeoutAction; logic_condition needs conditionType plus that condition's resource field; action_webhook needs an HTTPS url plus optional method, headers, body, resultKey, and onError; action_ai needs prompt, resultKey, and outputFields plus optional includeTags, includeEventProperties, includeRecentEvents, recentEventLimit, includeAttributes, and onError; logic_delay uses delayDays, delayHours, and delayMinutes. Fields that do not apply to the node type are dropped.

tagId.description: action_add_tag / action_remove_tag. Tag ID; tag actions resolve it by ID only, so pass a name in tagName instead. has_tag and does_not_have_tag also accept a tag name here. Missing tag definitions are created automatically.

tagName.description: action_add_tag / action_remove_tag / has_tag / does_not_have_tag. Tag name; use instead of tagId when you only know the name.

listId.description: action_add_to_list / action_remove_from_list / in_list. Must match an existing list in this company; listName is filled in for you.

listName.description: Optional cached list display name for list actions.

eventName.description: logic_wait_for_event and event_received conditions. Event to wait for or check.

timeoutDays.description: logic_wait_for_event. Maximum wait in whole days from 1 to 365. Defaults to 7.

timeoutAction.description: logic_wait_for_event. Continue to the next node or exit the sequence on timeout. Defaults to continue.
