conditionType.description: logic_condition. Condition evaluated before continuing. has_phone and sms_subscribed need no resource fields.

linkUrl.description: logic_condition. Optional URL substring for link_clicked. Omit to match any tracked click.

activityScope.description: logic_condition. Scope for event_received and link_clicked checks.

fieldName.description: logic_condition. Subscriber attribute name/path for field comparisons.

fieldValue.description: logic_condition. Comparison value for field comparisons.

url.description: action_webhook. Destination HTTPS URL called when a subscriber reaches this step. Supports merge tags like {{email}} and {{event.order_id}} resolved at execution time.

method.description: action_webhook. HTTP method. Defaults to POST.

headers.description: action_webhook. Optional string-valued request headers. Values support merge tags. Secret values are redacted on sequence reads.

body.description: action_webhook. Optional JSON body template for POST/PUT/PATCH requests. Must be valid JSON as written, with merge tags inside quoted string values; a tag in a bare value position is rejected. Tags are resolved at execution time. When omitted, a default payload with the subscriber and sequence context is sent.

resultKey.description: action_webhook / action_ai. Where the result is saved for the enrollment. Later steps reference it via {{webhooks.KEY.data.field}} (webhook) or {{ai.KEY.field}} (AI) merge tags. Required for action_ai. Must start with a letter and use only letters, numbers, or underscores (max 64 chars).

onError.description: action_webhook / action_ai. Behavior when the step fails - continue to the next step, exit the sequence, or fail the enrollment. Defaults to fail for webhooks and continue for AI steps (fallbacks fill the output fields).

prompt.description: action_ai. Prompt template sent to the model, resolved per contact at execution time. Supports merge tags like {{first_name}}, {{event.plan}}, and {{webhooks.KEY.data.field}}. Max 8000 characters.

outputFields.description: action_ai. Named values the model must return (1-10). Each key becomes a {{ai.KEY.<key>}} merge tag for later steps. fallback is used when generation fails so emails still send with sensible copy. Combined field maxLength values must fit the step's conservative 2000-token multilingual response budget plus JSON overhead.

key.description: Field key, e.g. subject_line. Must start with a letter and use only letters, numbers, or underscores (max 64 chars); unique within the step.

description.description: What the model should produce for this field. Max 300 characters.

maxLength.description: Hard cap on stored characters (1-4000). Defaults to 500. Output beyond it is cut.

fallback.description: Text used verbatim when generation fails or the model omits the field.

includeTags.description: action_ai. Include the contact's tags in the prompt context.

includeEventProperties.description: action_ai. Include the enrollment's trigger event name and properties in the prompt context.

includeRecentEvents.description: action_ai. Include the contact's most recent custom events (newest first) in the prompt context.

recentEventLimit.description: action_ai. How many recent events to include when includeRecentEvents is true. Defaults to 10.

includeAttributes.description: action_ai. Custom attribute keys to include in the prompt context (max 30). Only the listed keys are sent.

nodeId.description: Target action_sms node ID from GET /sequences/{sequenceId}.

text.description: Replacement plain-text message body. Merge tags like {{FIRST_NAME}} work. Provide text or blocks, not both.

blocks.description: Replacement SMS content blocks (text + image subset).

imageUrls.description: Up to 2 publicly reachable MMS image URLs. Only valid together with text.

label.description: Updated display label for the step.

ineligibleAction.description: Updated behavior when the contact can't receive SMS.

structuralStepNumber.description: Graph-derived email depth. Present on action_email and action_ab_test nodes reachable from a trigger; parallel branch emails intentionally share a depth.

updatedAt.description: Node concurrency timestamp. Return this as expectedUpdatedAt when patching the node.

updateHints.description: Type-aware guidance for safely patching this node.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Ready-to-return optimistic-concurrency token for update_sequence_node or update_sequence_nodes.

emailId.description: Email template holding this variant's stored copy.

blockCount.description: Number of blocks in this variant's body. Same as blocks.length.

blocks.description: This variant's email body. Present when ab_tests:read is granted. Step-level blocks remain control variant A only.

AbTestContentEditing.description: Where a sequence A/B step's copy lives and which tools change it.

SequenceAbTestStepSummary.description: A/B test attached to an action_ab_test step. The step's own subject, previewText, and blocks are control variant A only. With ab_tests:read, variants[] includes each variant's full blocks. Without ab_tests:read, record-backed fields are null and variants is empty while the configured id and editing guidance remain available.

nodeType.description: Step type. action_ab_test steps keep their copy on the A/B test variants; the fields below report control variant A.

abTest.description: Null on ordinary email steps. Present on action_ab_test steps.

structuralStepNumber.description: Graph-derived email depth, or null when the node is not reachable from a trigger. Parallel branch emails intentionally share a depth.

attachments.description: URL-backed file attachments configured on this email step, including event-backed URL templates.

emailPreset.description: Effective per-email Style > Format derived from native persisted blocks, including emails that contain supported custom HTML blocks. Null when the node has no linked email or the entire email is standalone raw HTML.

emailTheme.description: Theme override stored on this step's linked email. Null when the step has no override and renders on the company theme.

delayNodeId.description: ID of the logic_delay node immediately before this email, when present.

delayMs.description: Delay before this email in milliseconds, derived from the preceding logic_delay node when present.

delayMode.description: Delay mode for the preceding logic_delay node, when present.

waitUntil.description: Date-field wait metadata (field, source, direction, missingAction, pastAction, offset) for dynamic wait-until-date delays.

waitUntilWeekday.description: Weekday-window metadata for dynamic wait-until-weekday delays.

waitUntilKeyDate.description: Key-date wait metadata (key, direction, missingAction, pastAction, offset) for until_key_date delays.

delayDisplay.description: Human-readable delay before this email, derived from the preceding logic_delay node when present.

delayDescription.description: Description stored on the preceding logic_delay node, when present.

enrollmentPaused.description: Whether new enrollments are paused while current recipients continue.

acceptsNewEnrollments.description: Whether new subscribers can enter the sequence right now.

processesExistingEnrollments.description: Whether subscribers already inside the sequence keep advancing and receiving steps.

effectiveStatusSummary.description: One plain-language sentence describing the run state, safe to show a user verbatim.

frequencyCapEnabled.description: Whether email steps respect the company frequency cap.

bccEmails.description: Email addresses blind-copied on every email this sequence sends.

edges.description: Editable sequence topology. Pass the complete set back to graphEdit.edges when replacing edges.

graphRevision.description: Revision token for optimistic graph edits. Supply this as graphEdit.expectedRevision.

emailCount.description: Number of email-sending steps, including action_ab_test steps.

abTestCount.description: How many of the email steps are A/B test steps.

message.example: Sequence created with 2 emails and 1 discount action. Use POST /api/v1/sequences/{id}/enable to activate.

enrollmentPaused.description: Whether new enrollments are paused while current recipients continue.

acceptsNewEnrollments.description: Whether new subscribers can enter the sequence right now.

processesExistingEnrollments.description: Whether subscribers already inside the sequence keep advancing and receiving steps.

effectiveStatusSummary.description: One plain-language sentence describing the run state, safe to show a user verbatim.

frequencyCapEnabled.description: Whether email steps respect the company frequency cap.

warnings.description: Non-blocking advisories about a created sequence. Besides block and sender-identity advisories, POST /sequences reports request fields that were ignored (such as a nested `triggerConfig`, `delay: 2`, `delayDays` or a body `companyId` that differs from the selected company), `contact_added` list IDs not found in the company, and a `contact_added` trigger sent with no list and no `listScope`. The sequence is still created as a draft; fix these before enabling it. Absent when there is nothing to report.

eventTrackingCode.description: Code snippet returned for custom event triggers.

eventTracking.description: Endpoint, payload contract, example, documentation, and integration-guide pointer returned for custom event triggers.

propertyFilters.description: Normalized trigger filters that the event properties must satisfy before the sequence can enroll the subscriber.

examplePayloadMatchesFilters.description: Whether examplePayload already satisfies every normalized property filter. When false, adapt properties using payloadContract before sending the sample.

examplePayloadNote.description: Present when the generated example needs manual property adaptation before it satisfies every filter.

message.example: Sequence enabled

enrollmentPaused.description: Present for enable/disable and enrollment pause/resume actions.

acceptsNewEnrollments.description: Whether new subscribers can enter the sequence right now.

processesExistingEnrollments.description: Whether subscribers already inside the sequence keep advancing and receiving steps.

effectiveStatusSummary.description: One plain-language sentence describing the run state, safe to show a user verbatim.

warnings.description: Enable only. Non-blocking readiness warnings, such as empty branch paths or a `contact_added` trigger with no list, which enrolls every contact added to the company. Absent when there is nothing to report.

trackedValue.description: Tracked property total in minor units.

secret.description: Secret URL token. Treat it as a credential.

email.description: Dot path to the subscriber email in the webhook payload.

BulkSubscriberTagRequest.description: Provide tags plus at least one identifier list. Identifier lists may be combined and total at most 500 entries per request.

tags.description: Tag names applied to every matched subscriber. Names are normalized the same way as single-subscriber tag endpoints.

triggerAutomations.description: Add only. Whether tag_added sequences may enroll these contacts. Defaults to false and requires the automations:trigger scope.

success.description: False when any matched subscriber failed to update.

matched.description: Existing subscribers resolved from those identifiers.

unchanged.description: Subscribers that were already in the target state.

notFound.description: Identifiers that did not resolve. These subscribers were not created.

triggeredAutomations.description: Add only. Whether tag automations were allowed to run.

message.example: Tagged 2 subscribers (0 already in the target state, 0 failed).

SequenceEnrollmentCancelRequest.description: Provide exactly one target: cancelAll, subscriberId, subscriberIds, or fieldValues.

cancelAll.description: Cancel every active or waiting enrollment in the sequence, regardless of how contacts entered it. Use this when segment-triggered enrollments share no entry field value. Defaults to dry run unless dryRun is explicitly false.

subscriberId.description: Subscriber ID to cancel in this sequence.

subscriberIds.description: Up to 500 subscriber IDs to cancel in this sequence. IDs that do not resolve are returned in target.notFoundSubscriberIds. Defaults to dry run unless dryRun is explicitly false.

fieldPath.description: Dot-path inside the token's stored entry event properties. If omitted, the sequence enrollmentFieldPath is used.

dryRun.description: When true, returns matching enrollments without cancelling them. cancelAll, subscriberIds, and fieldValues default to dry run unless explicitly false; a single subscriberId cancels immediately.

reason.description: Optional reason stored on cancelled enrollment tokens.

fromNodeId.description: Node ID the contacts are currently sitting on, such as the delay step they are waiting at.

targetNodeId.description: Node ID to move them onto. Defaults to the source step's only next step, and is required when that step branches or is terminal. Cannot be the trigger node.

limit.description: Maximum enrollments to move in this call. Defaults to 100, maximum 500.

sort.description: Which enrollments to take first. Defaults to wait_until_asc, the contacts that have been waiting longest for their next step.

subscriberIds.description: Optional narrowing filter. Only move these subscribers, up to 500.

dailyLimit.description: Refuses to move more than this many enrollments onto targetNodeId in a rolling 24 hours, counting the moves recorded by earlier calls.

tags.description: Existing tag names applied to the moved contacts. Requires the subscribers:tag scope. Applying them never enrolls contacts in tag_added sequences.

reason.description: Note stored on every moved enrollment and returned as moveReason when listing enrollments.

dryRun.description: When true (the default), reports which enrollments would move without moving them.

effectiveLimit.description: How many this call was allowed to move after the daily guardrail was applied.

matchedCount.description: Movable enrollments parked on fromNodeId when the request started.

remainingCount.description: Movable enrollments still on fromNodeId. Repeat the same request while this is above zero.

skippedCount.description: Enrollments excluded because they are active, a worker is mid-step on them, or they are parked awaiting double opt-in. Only safely parked waiting tokens can be moved.

movedInWindow.description: Moves onto targetNodeId already recorded in the rolling 24-hour window.

enqueuedCount.description: Moved enrollments handed to the worker queue. Zero while the sequence is not running.

message.example: Moved 180 enrollments. 4140 still wait on the source step; repeat this request to release more.

matchedCount.description: Active or waiting enrollments matching the target when the request started.

cancelledCount.description: Enrollments cancelled by this request. Bulk cancellation is capped at 1000 per request.

remainingCount.description: Enrollments still matching the target after this request. Repeat the same request while this is above zero.

message.example: Cancelled 2 sequence enrollments.

SequenceEnrollmentRealignRequest.description: All fields are optional. With no body, every waiting enrollment in the sequence is previewed.

nodeIds.description: Step IDs to limit realignment to. Defaults to every step.

subscriberIds.description: Up to 500 subscriber IDs to limit realignment to. Defaults to every waiting contact.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor. When a response has hasMore true, pass its nextCursor here to continue after the enrollments already scanned.

dryRun.description: When true (the default), returns the new wait times without writing them. Set false to apply.

sendingWindow.description: The sequence sending window realignment anchored on, or null when only per-step weekday gates applied.

scannedCount.description: Waiting enrollments inspected by this request.

realignedCount.description: Waiting enrollments moved earlier, or that would move on a dry run. Capped at 1000 per request.

unchangedReasons.description: Counts per reason an enrollment did not move: already_at_window_start, already_due, day_not_allowed, no_shared_opening, no_window, not_email_bound, send_retry, raced.

requeueFailedCount.description: Enrollments whose new wait time was stored but whose wake-up could not be re-queued. The stuck-enrollment sweeper recovers these within a few minutes.

changes.description: Sample of up to 50 realigned enrollments.

hasMore.description: True when a per-request cap stopped the scan early. Continue with nextCursor while this is true.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor to pass as cursor on the next request when hasMore is true.

message.example: Realigned 330 waiting enrollments to the sending-window opening on the day they were already scheduled for.

result.description: Completed realignment result; null while queued, running, or failed.

statuses.description: Enrollment statuses included in this response.

stopCondition.description: The sequence's single configured stop condition, including any matchConfig event-property filters or field comparison. A sequence holds exactly one, so a stop event with any other name never applies. It is re-evaluated when an enrollment next runs a step, not when its event arrives.

stopConditionMatchEvaluatedCount.description: How many enrollments in this page were actually evaluated for a current stop-condition match. 0 when stopConditionMatch was not requested, the sequence has no stop condition, or no returned enrollment was still active or waiting.

enrollmentId.description: Enrollment token ID. Stable identifier for this one run through the sequence.

email.description: Subscriber email address. Falls back to the address captured at enrollment when the subscriber record no longer exists.

currentNodeId.description: Sequence node this enrollment is currently sitting on.

currentNodeType.description: Omitted when the node no longer exists in the sequence graph.

currentNodeLabel.description: Node label or email subject when available.

waitUntil.description: When a waiting enrollment is scheduled to resume, or null when nothing is scheduled.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Last change to this enrollment. For a waiting enrollment this is when it arrived at its current node.

failedReason.description: Why this enrollment stopped, for status `failed`. Null for every other status and for failures recorded before this field existed. The same reason repeated across enrollments on one `currentNodeId` points at that step rather than at the contacts.

movedFromNodeId.description: Step this enrollment was released from by POST /sequences/{sequenceId}/enrollments/move, or null when it reached its current step on its own.

movedAt.description: When that release happened, or null when the enrollment was never moved.

moveReason.description: Note recorded with that release, or null when none was given.

stopConditionMatches.description: Whether the sequence stop condition matches for this contact right now. Null when it was not determined - stopConditionMatch was not requested, the sequence has no stop condition, this enrollment is no longer active or waiting, or it fell outside the evaluated window. Null never means "does not match". This is a non-atomic snapshot; the worker re-checks before a future step, but the condition can change and a step already past its stop check may still finish.

stopConditionMatchReason.description: Human-readable reason the stop condition matches. Null when stopConditionMatches is not true.

enteredVia.description: What put this contact into the sequence. The distinguishing detail when a trigger covers several lists or tags.

kind.description: `inactivity` and `frequency` identify time-based evaluation of the monitored event rather than an ordinary event-received enrollment. `manual` is a dashboard or API enrollment that bypassed the trigger. `unknown` covers enrollments recorded before this field existed.

value.description: The list ID, tag name, segment ID, event name, or monitored event name. Null for `manual`, `test_run`, and `unknown`.

name.description: Resolved list or segment name. Set for list and segment kinds, and null when the referenced resource has since been deleted.

branchDecisions.description: Bounded redacted if/else and random-split verdicts, oldest first within the retained window. Compared values are summaries (missing, empty, nonempty, equals_expected), never the raw field or event-property value. Empty on enrollments recorded before this field existed; use GET /sequences/{sequenceId}/enrollments/{enrollmentId} to reconstruct those from ClickHouse.

branchDecisionCount.description: Total decisions taken, including decisions omitted from the bounded array.

branchDecisionsTruncated.description: Whether older decisions were omitted from branchDecisions.

SequenceEnrollmentEntryContext.description: Event or manual-enrollment context captured at entry. Property keys only; values from the enrolling payload are never returned.

triggerType.description: Stored entryTriggerType, such as event_received or manual_enrollment. Null when never stamped.

eventId.description: Durable ID of the enrolling event, or null.

hasEventProperties.description: Whether any event property keys were stored on this enrollment.

eventPropertyKeys.description: Keys present on the enrolling event payload. Values are omitted.

hasFieldSnapshots.description: Whether subscriber field snapshots were stored at enrollment.

fieldSnapshotKeys.description: Subscriber field paths snapshotted at enrollment. Values are omitted.

SequenceEnrollmentBranchDecision.description: One if/else or random-split verdict. Compared values are summaries, never the raw recipient value.

reason.description: Human-readable, already redacted. Never includes the compared value.
reason.example: Field catalogueStage not found on subscriber

enrollment.description: Same row shape as list sequence enrollments, including enteredVia, entryContext, and branchDecisions.

nodeHistory.description: ClickHouse graph-walk events for this token, oldest first.

nodeHistoryTruncated.description: Whether additional node events exist beyond the returned bounded history.

nodeHistoryLimit.description: Maximum number of node events returned.

historySource.description: Where the branch history came from.

event.description: Which notification to configure. weekly_report is the Monday summary of last week's sends, engagement, new subscribers, revenue, goals, and sequence trends; it is on by default for the workspace owner, off by default for invited members, and only sent for weeks with more than 10 emails sent.

mode.description: How to receive it. "instant" sends one email per occurrence, "daily" one summary per day, "weekly" one report per week. Instant form_submitted notifications stop after 50 per workspace per UTC day. "daily" is not supported for form_submitted or campaign_completed; weekly_report accepts only "off" or "weekly".

notificationPreferences.description: Every notification event available to this client with its current mode, defaults included. Node and Undici clients that omit x-sequenzy-client receive the three legacy events for compatibility.

supportedModes.description: Modes each event accepts, keyed by event.

defaults.description: Mode each event uses when the user has never configured it, resolved for the API key's user. The workspace owner defaults to weekly_report "weekly"; invited members default to "off".

consecutiveFailures.description: Consecutive failed delivery attempts used for endpoint backoff.

signingSecret.description: Returned only when creating a webhook or adding a signing secret.

signingSecrets.description: Active signing secret metadata. Secret values are returned only once.

failingSince.description: When the current unbroken run of failed deliveries started. `null` once a delivery succeeds.

autoDisabledAt.description: Set when Sequenzy disabled the endpoint automatically because every delivery failed for 7 days. Cleared when the endpoint is enabled again or its URL changes.

id.description: Member or invitation ID. The owner entry uses the literal id "owner".

lastMessagePreview.description: Plain-text preview of the latest subscriber or team reply, with quoted history, signatures and markup removed and truncated to 200 characters. Internal notes are not included. Null when no reply has readable text.

type.description: `inbound` for a subscriber reply, `outbound` for a team reply.
Where the conversation started: campaign, sequence, or transactional for replies to those emails, inbox for email sent to the company inbox address, or unknown.

InboxCustomAddress.description: The branded address you chose, or null.

address.description: The full address, such as support@inbound.acme.com. Null until the domain's inbound host is known.

status.description: `active` once the inbound MX record is verified; `pending` until then.

s3Key.description: Internal storage key. Present only when the file is stored.

downloadUrl.description: Signed download link valid for one hour, returned by Get Conversation for stored files. Null when the file was not stored (for example, attachment storage is not configured, the file was flagged by the virus scan, or its retention period ended).

type.description: inbound for received email, outbound for team replies, note for internal notes, and system for recorded forwards.

deliveryStatus.description: pending, sent, or failed for outbound messages and forwards. Null for notes.
